evidence.excerpt: The air in the sealed off pump is compressed quickly, hence work is done on the air. There is little time for heat transfer to occur, so Q ~ 0, and the change undergone by the gas is a good approximation to an adiabatic process. The increase in internal energy is indicated by the rise in temperature.

Compression of gas within bicycle pump heats gas; alternatively, syringe PV=nRT. The work done on the gas increases its internal energy, so increasing its temperature in accordance with the first law of thermodynamics.
